title: T009 — loop source not array
purpose: A :loop whose source path resolves to a scalar instead of an array should fail.
trigger: notArr resolves to the string "scalar", not an array, under :loop.
fix: Point :loop at an array path, or wrap the scalar in an array before looping.
notes: When the loop source is not an array the engine currently skips iteration and emits an empty result; it reports success and the stable T009 code is not yet emitted.
Ensure the :loop path resolves to an array so each element is iterated.
